QuestInfo.name: Tracking Down the Thief
QuestInfo.0: Tess has stuff to talk to you about.
QuestInfo.1: Tess says he's been trailing the Black Wings to gather clues about the Black Mage. He thinks there's a good chance the jewel thief is the Master of Disguise, from the Black Wings. \r\nTess wants you to go with him to Edelstein, the Black Wings' stronghold.
